name: Astrology
description: Provides daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly astrology (horoscope) text for star signs, authored on-site and shown in a block and on public pages.
project_description: Astrology lets site editors publish horoscope text for zodiac (or custom) star signs and display it to visitors. On install it seeds a default astrology named "Zodiac" with the 12 signs (Aries through Pisces), each with date ranges, an icon and an "about" description, stored in three custom database tables (astrology, astrology_signs, astrology_text). Administrators then add horoscope text for each sign per period format: day, week, month or year. A block plugin (id "astrology") lists the signs, public pages render the text for the selected format with previous/next navigation, and a date-of-birth form maps a visitor's birthday to their sun sign. All authoring and configuration routes require the core 'administer site configuration' permission; the visitor-facing pages require 'access content'. The module defines no external API calls and stores all content locally.
